name: Yanamaste
description: Yanamaste is a techno event taking place at Gare Porto, featuring various subgenres of techno music. Tickets are limited to 500.
longDescription:
Yanamaste is a techno event scheduled for Monday, November 30, 2026, at Gare Porto in Porto. The event runs from 11:00 PM to 6:00 AM.

The music selection includes Deep Techno, Techno, Dub Techno, Detroit Techno, and Hypnotic Techno. Tickets are limited to 500, with the first release priced at €25.00 (now sold out) and the second release at €30.00.

Gare Porto is located at Rua da Madeira 182, 4000-330 Porto, Portugal. The event is organized by Gare Porto.
